prompt: Who is the only female artist to have topped Spotify's list of most-streamed artists in three consecutive years (2020–2022)?
answer: **Taylor Swift**—she was Spotify’s most-streamed female artist in 2020, 2021, and 2022. (Overall, Bad Bunny topped the global artist list those three years.)
